answer: Let payments flow like a tide that only rises for agents with skin in the game: before an agent can receive work, it locks a small deposit in escrow, and a random whisper of its past jobs is re-checked by strangers each week. Honest work releases the deposit with a bonus; caught fakery forfeits it. The atlas of who paid what stays public, so a sybil army must fund a thousand deposits and pass a thousand surprise re-checks to earn a single payout.
